name: Steam Purifier
notes: Steam multiblock: runs on steam from steam input hatches, no energy or maintenance hatch. Every tiered part (machine casing, gear box, pipe casing, firebox, frame) must be the same tier: bronze (shown) or steel (Solid Steel Machine Casing and steel parts; high-pressure steam, faster). Buses are steam input/output buses. Steam washer (Steam Purifier), 9x6x5, at least 55 machine casings. The basin (glass, marked as air here) holds water; a normal input hatch supplies water for recipes. GT turns hatches and buses north, the same way as the controller (allowOnly(NORTH), an auto-placement hint). The controller sits one block back from the front. Sharing: every hatch found during the structure check is added to each controller whose structure contains it, so steam hatches and buses in a shared wall serve both machines.
